implementation.status_at_handoff: Not started; in-memory once-only callback armed and timer confirmed

implementation.requires: Keep the existing Vivado GUI session open
implementation.callback: set ::volume_impl_once_state armed; set ::volume_build_log {E:/FPGA_Prj/Xilinx/Model_Deployment/prj/Model_Deployment.srcs/sim_1/new/Volume_DDR_20261025/results/build_progress.log}; proc volume_build_note {message} {set f [open $::volume_build_log a]; puts $f "[clock format [clock seconds] -format {%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}] $message"; close $f}; proc volume_launch_impl_once {} {if {$::volume_impl_once_state ne "armed"} {return}; set s [get_property STATUS [get_runs synth_1]]; if {[string match {*Complete*} $s] && [get_property PROGRESS [get_runs synth_1]] eq "100%"} {set ::volume_impl_once_state launching; volume_build_note "SYNTHESIS_COMPLETE: $s; starting impl_1 once through route_design"; if {[catch {launch_runs impl_1 -to_step route_design -jobs 4} reason]} {set ::volume_impl_once_state launch_failed; volume_build_note "IMPLEMENTATION_LAUNCH_FAILED: $reason"} else {set ::volume_impl_once_state launched; volume_build_note "IMPLEMENTATION_LAUNCHED: [get_property STATUS [get_runs impl_1]]"}; return}; if {[string match -nocase {*error*} $s] || [string match -nocase {*fail*} $s] || [string match -nocase {*cancel*} $s]} {set ::volume_impl_once_state synth_failed; volume_build_note "SYNTHESIS_STOPPED_NO_RETRY: $s"; return}; set ::volume_impl_once_timer [after 30000 volume_launch_impl_once]}; volume_build_note {ARMED: one synthesis run; launch implementation once only after successful synthesis; no bitstream and no retry}; list callback_state $::volume_impl_once_state procedure [info procs volume_launch_impl_once] synthesis [get_property STATUS [get_runs synth_1]] implementation [get_property STATUS [get_runs impl_1]]
